behaviors_covered.oscillators.timer_555_astable: Complete non-default charge/discharge oracle; C scaling, cycle identities, equal-resistor duty, RA/RB->0+, 100 kHz screen on both representable sides, tiny-C rejection and recovery; finite-time-constant overflow regression. Every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input is followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.oscillators.comparator_rc_oscillator: Complete non-default asymmetric oracle; independent KCL and exponential endpoint checks, supply and threshold-resistor scaling, resistor swap, symmetric duty, 1e-16 hysteresis and overflow regression. Every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input is followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.oscillators.triangle_integrator_oscillat: Complete non-default RT/RF=2.5 oracle (no false swing-ratio bound); capacitor charge balance, amplitude-invariant period, RT/RI scaling, tiny thresholds, finite-period overflow regression. Every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input is followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.oscillators.wien_bridge_balance: Complete below-unity oracle; marginal/decaying/growing diagnostics, one-ulp positive excess, independent bridge/gain-network scaling, finite-RC frequency overflow regression. Every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input is followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.oscillators.loaded_rc_phase_shift: Complete decaying oracle; loaded complex ladder beta=-1/29 with roundoff-only imaginary tolerance, marginal gain 29, C and R/RF scaling, finite-RC frequency overflow regression. Every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input is followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.oscillators.cross_coupled_lc_startup: Complete non-default differential oracle; characteristic-polynomial real/imaginary balance, marginal/decaying/growing modes, positive and negative repeated-pole boundaries with recovery, startup-ratio overflow regression. Every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input is followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.oscillators.pierce_crystal_startup: Complete failed-margin oracle; zero C0/Cs, ESR and frequency scaling, target=1, independently computed zero-headroom boundary, one-ulp positive external capacitance, CL<=Cs rejection/recovery, critical-gm square underflow regression. Every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input is followed by fully asserted valid recovery.

oracle_provenance: Non-default vectors derived independently with 60-digit Decimal arithmetic, explicit 60-digit pi, and physical KCL/charge/characteristic laws. Source register inherited from research/expansion/oscillators.md; no renewed manufacturer retrieval claimed.
verification: Not executed. No builds, tests, lint, formatter, backend process or native launches. Independent arithmetic only; all 28 Rust tests and 35 flat process scenarios await Main.
untested_gaps: Main must compile and run the oscillator integration target and full integrated suite.
Main must run flat scenarios in one real JSON-lines process and inspect native scenarios; seven conditioning regressions are expected to expose current source defects, not observed failures.
No physical hardware validation, amplitude stabilization, comparator delay, device bandwidth or crystal drive-power qualification.
No exhaustive binary64 domain sweep; physical unrepresentability differs from avoidable intermediate failures.

suspected_defects.contradiction: RA*C=RB*C=1 s; high interval traverses the same 2:1 threshold ratio through two resistors, low through one. RA+RB and RA+2RB overflow before finite C scaling.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate with scale-aware multiplication/division or normalized ratios; do not add arbitrary physical bounds to hide finite-output arithmetic failures.

suspected_defects.contradiction: Symmetric supply/ground branches set both rounded thresholds to 1 V; hysteresis remains 1e-308 relative and gives 1e-8 s intervals. RF ratios and supply multiplication overflow; normalized conductances avoid this.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate with scale-aware multiplication/division or normalized ratios; do not add arbitrary physical bounds to hide finite-output arithmetic failures.

suspected_defects.contradiction: RI*C=1 s and RT/RF=1; the 2 V ramp takes 2 s in each direction. 4*RI overflows before multiplication by C.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate with scale-aware multiplication/division or normalized ratios; do not add arbitrary physical bounds to hide finite-output arithmetic failures.

suspected_defects.contradiction: R*C=0.01 s, so omega=100 rad/s; divide-by-R first overflows despite finite final frequency. Vector supplied independently by V2OscillatorsRun.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate with scale-aware multiplication/division or normalized ratios; do not add arbitrary physical bounds to hide finite-output arithmetic failures.

suspected_defects.contradiction: R*C=0.01 s and RF/R=30; coupled ladder has omega*RC=1/sqrt(6). Divide-by-R first overflows despite finite frequency. Vector supplied independently by V2OscillatorsRun.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate with scale-aware multiplication/division or normalized ratios; do not add arbitrary physical bounds to hide finite-output arithmetic failures.

suspected_defects.contradiction: Pair conductance is 1 S and loss 1e-308 S. Startup ratio is 1e308, not infinity; gm*Rp overflows before /2.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate with scale-aware multiplication/division or normalized ratios; do not add arbitrary physical bounds to hide finite-output arithmetic failures.

suspected_defects.contradiction: At f*CL=1e-200 S, multiplying ESR before squaring underflows is avoidable. Critical gm=16*pi^2*1e-200 S, all five outputs remain representable.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate with scale-aware multiplication/division or normalized ratios; do not add arbitrary physical bounds to hide finite-output arithmetic failures.
